name: vscode-zai-usage-plus
description: Display z.ai token usage in the status bar

commands.title: z.ai Usage Plus: Set API Key
z.ai Usage Plus: Clear API Key
z.ai Usage Plus: Refresh Status Bar

zaiUsagePlus.refreshInterval.description: Data refresh interval in seconds (minimum: 10, default: 60)

zaiUsagePlus.useIcon.description: Use z.ai icon in status bar instead of text label 'z.ai:'

zaiUsagePlus.statusBarPriority.description: Priority of the z.ai Usage Plus item in the status bar (higher = further left among right-aligned items). Change takes effect after reloading the window.

zaiUsagePlus.displayMode.description: Whether to display token usage or remaining tokens in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Full labels with reset countdowns (e.g. 45% (2h30m) | Week: 12% (3d12h))
Short labels with reset countdowns (e.g. 45% (2h30m) | W: 12% (3d12h))
Short labels, bare percentages only (e.g. 45% | W: 12%)
zaiUsagePlus.displayStyle.description: How verbose the status bar label should be. The tooltip always shows full details.

zaiUsagePlus.showWeekly.description: Show the weekly token usage alongside the 5-hour usage in the status bar.

zaiUsagePlus.showMcp.description: Show the MCP quota alongside the other windows in the status bar.
